clue.text: Merit of the French-ever surprising!

explanation.definitionFit: To merit something is to be worthy of it, a straight verb synonym.

clue.text: Gets food into sailing men, so causing delay

parts.note: tars is an old word for sailors
to dine is to eat a meal, so gets food is dines

explanation.surface: Feeding the crew holds up the voyage.
explanation.definitionFit: Lateness is a synonym for delay, the state of being held up.

clue.text: The ambassador offers support with a note

parts.note: a leg supports a table or chair
te is the seventh note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: A diplomat offers backing along with a written message.
explanation.definitionFit: A papal envoy or emissary is the sense, close to an ambassador.

clue.text: Time for a stop

explanation.surface: A request for a pause or break.
explanation.definitionFit: One sense is an era or span; the other is the full stop that ends a sentence, as Americans call it.

clue.text: State shortly the jerk is to be pitied

parts.note: PA is the short form of Pennsylvania, a US state
a tic is an involuntary twitch or jerk

explanation.surface: Briefly declaring that some idiot deserves sympathy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'jerk' reads as an insult but is the twitch TIC.
explanation.definitionFit: Something pitiable arouses sympathy or sorrow, the core sense.

clue.text: A woman may get had or twisted

indicators.note: twisted means bent out of shape, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A suggestion that a woman might be cheated or have her words distorted.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a female first name, so any woman bearing it fits.

clue.text: Superior to play-actors, though really not very bright

parts.note: over means above or ranking higher than
the cast is the group of actors in a play

explanation.surface: Ranking above the actors, though not especially clever.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not very bright' suggests dim-witted; it means cloudy weather.
explanation.definitionFit: A cloudy sky is dull and lacks sunshine.

clue.text: Treatise being badly written, does it over again

indicators.note: a text that is badly written is muddled, so the letters of treatise are rearranged

explanation.surface: A poorly written academic paper keeps repeating itself.
explanation.definitionFit: To repeat an action or statement is the plain sense.

clue.text: Bowed, and dashed about as well

indicators.note: about means around, so the rushing word goes round the extra word

parts.note: to dash is to hurry, so dashed is sped
too means also or as well

explanation.surface: Someone bowed and also hurried about.
explanation.definitionFit: To bend the head and shoulders forward is to bow.

clue.text: Should start to get together some crockery

indicators.note: the start of a word is its first letter, here of should

parts.note: to herd is to gather animals or people into a group

explanation.surface: Advice to collect a set of dishes.
explanation.definitionFit: A shard or fragment of broken pottery, a piece of crockery.

clue.text: To make a cut without the queen suffering

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so the cutting word goes round the queen

parts.note: to lance is to cut open, as a boil
ER, Elizabeth Regina, stands for the Queen

explanation.surface: Performing an operation without royal approval.
explanation.definitionFit: Sufferance, the putting up with something, is the old sense of the definition.

clue.text: An alternative to a key ring

parts.note: or introduces an alternative
B is a musical key

explanation.surface: Something to replace a key on a ring.
explanation.definitionFit: A sphere or circle is a ring shape.

clue.text: Using lever and breaking it is a bloomer

indicators.note: breaking smashes something up, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Snapping a crowbar in use would be a blunder.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bloomer' suggests a gaffe; it means a flowering plant.
explanation.definitionFit: A flowering shrub is literally something that blooms.

clue.text: One thousand strike an attitude when put on

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
M is the Roman numeral for a thousand
to pose is to adopt a posture

explanation.surface: A crowd of a thousand posing when wearing costume.
explanation.definitionFit: To force a burden on someone is to inflict it.

clue.text: Thinks the current recession has divided friends

indicators.note: divided means split apart, so the friends are split by the other piece

parts.note: mates are friends

parts.note: a tide is a current of the sea

explanation.surface: Economic gloom has split pals, someone muses.
explanation.walkthrough: 'recession' turns TIDE into EDIT, placed inside MATES.
explanation.definitionFit: To ponder or contemplate deeply is to reflect.

clue.text: Fill report in like a star

indicators.note: one piece goes in the other, so the telling word sits inside the filling word

parts.note: to sate is to fill to satisfaction
to tell is to report

explanation.surface: Instruction to fill in a report form in a starry way.
explanation.definitionFit: Star-shaped, radiating from a centre, is the botanical sense.

clue.text: Cutting dictum

explanation.surface: A sharp remark that sounds like a maxim.
explanation.definitionFit: One is the toothed tool used for cutting wood; the other is an old proverb or saying.

clue.text: He insists different sorts are required

indicators.note: different means changed, so these letters are reordered

explanation.surface: Various kinds are needed.
explanation.definitionFit: One who affirms or maintains a claim forcefully insists on it.

clue.text: Decorate a cake in the nicest possibly fashion

indicators.note: the letters sit inside the words the nicest

explanation.surface: Advice to decorate a cake as nicely as possible.
explanation.definitionFit: Coating a cake with sugar topping is to frost it.

clue.text: Finding the way about sea-going craft occasions some anxiety

parts.note: St is the abbreviation for street, a way
re means concerning or about
SS is a steamship

explanation.surface: Navigating near ships causes worry.
explanation.definitionFit: Strain or worry, mental pressure, is the sense.

clue.text: Copy a series of exercises

parts.note: PE, physical education, is a set of exercises

explanation.surface: Mimicking a gym routine.
explanation.definitionFit: To mimic, as a monkey is said to, is to copy.

clue.text: Quite defenceless, so Venus was found

explanation.surface: The famous armless statue of Venus left without protection.
explanation.walkthrough: The Venus de Milo statue was discovered without arms.
explanation.definitionFit: Without weapons means defenceless; without arms is how the Milo statue was unearthed.

clue.text: Sick people put neckwear among underwear

indicators.note: among puts the neckwear inside the underwear

parts.note: pants are underwear in Britain
a tie is worn around the neck

explanation.surface: Ill people dress oddly with a tie in their underpants.
explanation.definitionFit: Those under medical care are invalids or the sick.

clue.text: Tacking onto a minister-popular German Re leader

parts.note: DD, Doctor of Divinity, is a minister's degree
in means fashionable or popular

explanation.surface: A trendy German clergyman attaching something.

explanation.definitionFit: Joining or appending something is attaching it.

clue.text: Detective involved in hustle

indicators.note: involved means tangled, so the letters of hustle are rearranged

explanation.surface: A private eye caught up in a hustle.
explanation.definitionFit: An investigator, like a bloodhound, tracks things down.

clue.text: The soldiers coming in appeared injured-gassed

parts.note: someone who bled showed a wound
RE, the Royal Engineers, are soldiers

explanation.surface: Troops arrived wounded and gassed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gassed' suggests chemical attack; it means chattered nonsense.
explanation.definitionFit: To talk at length foolishly is to prattle or chatter.

clue.text: Mean drunk

explanation.surface: A nasty inebriated person.
explanation.definitionFit: Stingy with money is one sense; intoxicated is the slang other.

clue.text: A large stretch of water where birds can raise their young

definitions.text: where birds can raise their young

parts.note: Erie is one of the North American Great Lakes

clue.text: Anything in New York that's exasperating

indicators.note: one piece goes inside New York's abbreviation

parts.note: aught is an old word for anything

explanation.surface: Everything in New York is irritating.
explanation.definitionFit: Misbehaving, mischievous behaviour exasperates.

clue.text: The principal returns

parts.note: the money a capital sum yields, read as a head teacher coming back

explanation.surface: The head teacher comes back.
explanation.definitionFit: Money earned on a loan or deposit is what capital yields.

clue.text: High minded individual interrupting a fellow just to annoy

indicators.note: interrupting breaks into, so the saint goes into the fellow

parts.note: Peter is a man's name, any fellow

explanation.surface: A lofty person breaking in on someone just to be irritating.
